The Self-Hosted File Converter

Convert anything, anywhere.

Transmute is an open-source, self-hosted file converter that handles images, video, audio, data, documents, and more; all on your own hardware.No uploads to third-party servers. No file size limits. No watermarks.

Get StartedView on GitHub

See the Self-Hosted File Converter in Action

A clean, modern interface designed for efficiency. Upload, convert, download, that's it.

Format Support

Supported Conversions

Powered by FFmpeg, Pillow, Pandoc, and more, Transmute converts images, video, documents, fonts, and many other formats.

Browse All Conversions
Why Self-Host?

Why Use a Self-Hosted File Converter?

Stop uploading sensitive files to random websites. Take full control of your file conversions.

100% Private

Your files never leave your machine. Full privacy with zero third-party uploads. Perfect for sensitive documents and proprietary data.

Fast & Simple

Clean REST API powered by FastAPI. Beautiful web UI for drag-and-drop conversions. Upload a file, pick your format, get your result.

No Limits

No file size caps, no watermarks, no rate limits, no paid tiers. Convert as much as you need, as often as you need.

Access Control

OIDC / SSO Integration

Let users sign in to Transmute with Authentik, Authelia, or any OpenID Connect provider instead of managing separate local credentials.

Read the OIDC Docs

Quickstart

Deploy in seconds with Docker Compose. One command, fully running.

Warning

Think carefully before exposing Transmute to the public internet / WAN. Transmute includes built-in authentication and per-user data isolation, but is designed for trusted networks. If you expose it beyond your LAN, place it behind a reverse proxy with TLS and rate limiting. The maintainers are not responsible for security issues arising from your deployment configuration.

$ wget "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/transmute-app/transmute/refs/heads/main/docker-compose.yml" && docker compose up -d
docker-compose.yml
services:
  transmute:
    image: ghcr.io/transmute-app/transmute:latest
    container_name: transmute
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
        - 3313:3313
    volumes:
      - transmute_data:/app/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - "CMD"
        - "wget"
        - "-q"
        - "-O"
        - "/dev/null"
        - "--tries=1"
        - "http://localhost:3313/api/health/ready"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s

volumes:
  transmute_data:

Then open http://localhost:3313 in your browser.

Full API Access

Every conversion available through the UI is also available via a REST API. ReDocly formatted docs are served at /api/docs when the app is running.
